levels.name: Diagnostic Integrity
levels.purpose: Validate the diagnostics frame before trusting its output.

levels.name: Target Context
levels.purpose: Resolve target, runtime context, VCS state, paths and basic executability.

levels.name: Repository Inventory
levels.purpose: Collect bounded evidence about repository shape and capabilities.

levels.name: Repository Hygiene
levels.purpose: Detect repository integrity and hygiene hazards.

levels.name: Tooling Discovery
levels.purpose: Discover project manifests, automation surfaces and candidate tools.

levels.name: Canonical Software Validators
levels.purpose: Execute explicit MediKristal validators: application tests and frontend JavaScript syntax.

levels.name: Security Hygiene
levels.purpose: Perform bounded conservative secret and sensitive-file hygiene checks.

levels.name: MediKristal Identity and Layout
levels.purpose: Verify that the target is the expected MediKristal 0.2.0 repository and that required source, contract, UI, migration and test surfaces exist.

levels.name: Contract and Traceability Integrity
levels.purpose: Independently validate OpenAPI/domain/traceability invariants, runtime asset parity and acceptance-matrix completeness.

levels.name: Runtime API Smoke
levels.purpose: Boot the FastAPI application on an isolated SQLite database and verify health, readiness, OpenAPI parity, UI serving, security headers and honest capability states.

levels.name: Migration Cycle
levels.purpose: Run Alembic upgrade -> downgrade base -> upgrade on a disposable SQLite database and inspect critical integrity tables.

levels.name: Packaging and Provenance
levels.purpose: Verify delivery manifest hashes, wheel checksum/metadata/assets, SBOM-lock agreement and packaged contract/frontend parity.

levels.name: Generated Artifact Reproducibility
levels.purpose: Regenerate contracts, validation evidence, runtime assets, SBOM and manifest in a temporary copy and detect checked-in drift without mutating the target.

levels.name: Delivery Claims Consistency
levels.purpose: Cross-check documented test/contract counts against fresh collection and generated validation evidence, keeping software and documentary evidence distinct.

levels.name: Deployment Configuration
levels.purpose: Validate Compose topology, secret handling, non-root container intent and explicit external-integration limitations without starting Docker.

baseline.description: Read-oriented repository and MediKristal identity diagnostics.

software.description: Baseline plus canonical software validators, runtime smoke and migration cycle.

delivery.description: Software validation plus packaging/provenance and deployment configuration.

release.description: Full non-network release evidence including reproducibility and claims consistency.

deep.description: Alias of the full release evidence campaign.
